assets.title: Outdoor Season Timeline — Weather + Plant Phenology
assets.purpose: Link site preparation, acclimation, transplant establishment, vegetative/reproductive milestones, weather events, scouting and harvest checkpoints to local observations instead of fixed national calendar dates.
assets.diagnosticUse: Shows why plant stage and local conditions are more informative than assuming a crop should be at a specific stage because of the month.

assets.title: Outdoor Microclimate Map — Measure the Site, Not the Forecast
assets.purpose: Show slope, low spots, walls/fences, windbreaks, shade, canopy edge and sensor locations with paired zone measurements.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps explain why one section repeatedly experiences cold, heat, humidity or slow drying while a nearby zone does not.

assets.title: Cold-Air Drainage & Frost-Pocket Risk
assets.purpose: Illustrate cold-air movement downslope, pooling in low areas and the difference between a regional weather reading and crop-zone temperature.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps distinguish localized cold/frost injury from disease or generalized regional conditions.

assets.title: Extreme Weather Field Card
assets.purpose: Provide separate evidence checklists for heat, cold/freeze, wind, heavy rain/flooding and hail rather than collapsing them into one generic stress label.
assets.diagnosticUse: Links each event type to the measurements, immediate injury patterns and follow-up recovery checks most useful for differential diagnosis.

assets.title: Wildfire Smoke & Haze — What to Record, What Not to Assume
assets.purpose: Separate AQI/PM2.5 worker-safety context, haze/radiation changes, visible particulate deposition and plant observations from unsupported claims about crop safety or remediation.
assets.diagnosticUse: Prevents visible ash, odor or haze from being converted into an unverified contamination or quality conclusion.

assets.title: End-of-Season Evidence Review — Keep, Change, Test
assets.purpose: Summarize plant/cohort outcomes, major events, verified interventions, unresolved diagnoses and the next-season experiments suggested by the evidence.
assets.diagnosticUse: Keeps missing data and unresolved diagnoses visible instead of converting memory into certainty at season end.
